run_metadata_extractor_cli: run the metadata extractor CLI to extract scene and episode metadata from a PARTNR dataset
extract_scene_metadata: extract scene metadata including furniture, receptacles, and room IDs for all scenes in a dataset
extract_episode_metadata: extract episode metadata mapping objects to receptacles, rooms, and states for all episodes
save_episode_metadata: save episode metadata as individual JSON files to a specified output directory
load_scene_cache: load previously cached scene metadata from a directory to skip re-extraction
